_note: Hand-authored stadium for SYN-001 (home of Brackwater Athletic). Invented. Sector capacities must add up to the total capacity (checked by the validator).
name: Lanternworks Stadium
roof: covers every seat; the pitch is open
history: Built on the site of the Harrow Quay lamp factory where the club was founded. The four red-brick chimneys of the factory were kept and stand behind the North stand; at night they are lit amber.
notable_matches: August 2004: the opening match, a 2-2 draw with Calderholm United in the Estuary Derby.
August 2018: Brackwater beat Ravensgate City 2-1 to win the Meridian Super Shield, the first trophy lifted at the Lanternworks.
2019/20: the record attendance of 60,388, for the derby against Calderholm United.
May 2022: the stadium hosted the Meridian Cup final, won by Hollin Vale United.

stands.name: Foundry End
stands.description: Behind the north goal. Home supporters' singing section; the amber light display starts here.

stands.name: Harbour Stand
stands.description: Behind the south goal, facing the harbour. Away supporters sit in S6 and S7, with their own entrance.

stands.name: Lamplighters Stand
stands.description: Along the east touchline. Sectors E1 to E3 are the family zone.

stands.name: Main Stand
stands.description: Along the west touchline, with the players' tunnel, the dugouts, the press box and the Club Level.

gates.note: Away supporters only. Next to the ferry pier.

services.name: Foundry Grill
services.offer: hot pies, sausage rolls, chips, veggie wraps

services.name: Harbour Bites
services.offer: fish finger sandwiches, chips, falafel bowls

services.name: Family Kitchen
services.offer: kids' meal boxes, pasta pots, fruit cups, ice cream

services.name: Lamplighters Café
services.offer: coffee, tea, hot chocolate, cakes, vegan sandwiches

services.name: Main Stand Deli
services.offer: deli sandwiches, soups, salads, gluten-free options

services.name: Soft drinks and water
services.offer: water, juices, soft drinks, tea and coffee

services.name: Sensory room
services.offer: a quiet room with a view of the pitch, for fans who need a calmer space; book at the Family Desk

services.name: Audio-described commentary
services.offer: free headsets for blind and partially sighted fans; collect at Gate G

services.name: Family Desk
services.offer: lost children point, ear defenders for kids, sensory room booking

services.name: Lamplighters Store
services.offer: shirts, scarves, souvenirs; open from 3 hours before kick-off

services.name: Club museum
services.offer: open before the match for Club Level ticket holders

transport.detail: Tram line 2 to the 'Lanternworks' stop, 300 m from Gate G. Extra trams run after the match.
Brackwater Harbour station, a 15-minute walk along the quay.
Park-and-ride from the Brackwater Ring Road, every 10 minutes from 2 hours before kick-off.
Free bike racks at Gates C and D.
The estuary ferry ('the derby boat') lands at Lantern Pier, next to Gate F, the away entrance.

policies: Bags larger than an A4 sheet are not allowed; there is no left-luggage service.
The whole stadium, inside and outside the stands, is smoke-free.
Glass, cans, flares and fireworks are not allowed.
All kiosks are cashless: cards and phones only.
Re-entry is not allowed once you leave the stadium.
Children under 14 must be with an adult.
